title: Airbnb Damage Deposit
scenario: A host asks for a security deposit outside the platform after check-in.

answers.A: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.B: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.C: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.
answers.D: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.

explanation: Airbnb Damage Deposit: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Deposits should remain inside the booking platform.
